objective.description: Online matches should feel like offline play.

expected.summary: Lead with "Emulated-RTT action test: perceived_action_latency <= 100ms" (high), then investigate before changing code. 2 test suggestions, 2 fix steps.

suggestions.title: Emulated-RTT action test: perceived_action_latency <= 100ms
suggestions.rationale: EG-G03 --realized-by--> KR-G03a --verified-by--> TP-G03-1. A supplied measurement already exceeds this budget. This budget is a proposal from the experience goal catalog, not a caller decision; confirm or replace the number.

draft.description: Given two headless clients connected through network emulation at the supported RTT ceiling, when a scripted action fires, then the acting client’s perceived action latency must be within the budget.

suggestions.title: Tick budget guardrail: tick_overrun_count <= 0count
suggestions.rationale: EG-G03 --realized-by--> KR-G03b --verified-by--> TP-G03-2. This budget is a proposal from the experience goal catalog, not a caller decision; confirm or replace the number.

draft.description: Given the server under representative match load, when tick durations are measured externally, then p99 tick duration must fit the tick interval.

steps.title: Profile before changing code
steps.description: Measure and locate the bottleneck first; optimization guesses usually miss.

steps.title: Optimize the located hotspot, guarded by the measurement
steps.description: Apply the smallest effective change and keep the external guardrail as the arbiter.

risks.description: Optimizations often trade readability or memory for speed; the measurement must justify the trade.

fixPolicy.rollback: Revert the optimization if the external measurement shows no improvement or a regression elsewhere.
